source: Good morning, my name is Amina and I am the nurse today.
translation: Habari za asubuhi, jina langu ni Amina na mimi ndiye muuguzi wa leo.
back_translation: Good morning, my name is Amina and I am today's nurse.

source: What is your name?
translation: Jina lako ni nani?

source: Please sit down here.
translation: Tafadhali kaa chini hapa.

source: I am going to ask you some questions about your health.
translation: Nitakuuliza maswali kuhusu afya yako.
back_translation: I will ask you questions about your health.

source: Is it okay if I examine you?
translation: Je, ni sawa nikikuchunguza?
back_translation: Is it okay if I look at you?

source: How old are you?
translation: Una umri gani?

source: She is 34 years old.
translation: Ana umri wa miaka 34.

source: The child is 5 years old.
translation: Mtoto ana umri wa miaka 5.

source: Where do you live?
translation: Unaishi wapi?

source: Do you have a phone number we can call?
translation: Je, una namba ya simu tunayoweza kupiga?
back_translation: Do you have a phone number we can call?

source: What brings you to the clinic today?
translation: Ni nini kinachokuleta kliniki leo?
back_translation: What brings you to the clinic today?

source: How long have you had a fever?
translation: Umekuwa na homa kwa muda gani?
back_translation: How long have you had a fever?

source: I have had a fever for 3 days.
translation: Nimekuwa na homa kwa siku 3.
back_translation: I have had a fever for 3 days.

source: Do you have a cough?
translation: Je, una kikohozi?

source: The cough started two weeks ago.
translation: Kikohozi kilianza wiki mbili zilizopita.
back_translation: The cough started two weeks ago.

source: Do you have pain when you pass urine?
translation: Je, una maumivu unapotoa mkojo?
back_translation: Do you experience pain when urinating?

source: Where does it hurt?
translation: Inaumiza wapi?

source: The pain is in my lower belly.
translation: Maumivu ni katika tumbo langu la chini.
back_translation: The pain is in my lower abdomen.

source: Have you been vomiting?
translation: Je, umekuwa ukimwaga?

source: He has vomited four times since this morning.
translation: Ametapika mara nne tangu asubuhi ya leo.
back_translation: He has been vomiting four times since this morning.

source: Does the child have diarrhoea?
translation: Je, mtoto ana ugonjwa wa kuhara?

source: The child is not breastfeeding well.
translation: Mtoto hana maziwa ya kutosha ya kunyonyesha.
back_translation: The baby does not have enough milk to breastfeed.

source: Is the child able to drink?
translation: Je, mtoto anaweza kunywa?

source: Has the child had any convulsions?
translation: Je, mtoto huyo amepatwa na mshtuko wowote?
back_translation: Has the child experienced any seizures?

source: Do you feel dizzy when you stand up?
translation: Je, unahisi kizunguzungu unaposimama?
back_translation: Do you feel dizzy when you stand?

source: I cannot sleep at night because of the pain.
translation: Siwezi kulala usiku kwa sababu ya maumivu.
back_translation: I can't sleep at night because of the pain.

source: Your temperature is 38.5 degrees.
translation: Joto lako ni digrii 38.5.

source: Your blood pressure is 140/90.
translation: Shinikizo lako la damu ni 140/90.

source: The baby weighs 6 kg.
translation: Mtoto ana uzito wa kilo 6.

source: I am going to measure your blood pressure.
translation: Nitaenda kupima shinikizo lako la damu.
back_translation: I'm going to measure your blood pressure.

source: Have you been sick like this before?
translation: Je, umewahi kuwa mgonjwa kama huyu?
back_translation: Have you ever been sick like this?

source: Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
translation: Je, una ugonjwa wa kisukari au shinikizo la juu la damu?
back_translation: Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?

source: Have you been tested for HIV?
translation: Je, umepimwa virusi vya UKIMWI?
back_translation: Have you been tested for HIV?

source: Is anyone at home sick with the same problem?
translation: Je, kuna mtu yeyote nyumbani aliye na tatizo hilohilo?
back_translation: Does anyone in the household have the same problem?

source: Has the child received all vaccinations?
translation: Je, mtoto amepokea chanjo zote?
back_translation: Has the child received all the vaccines?

source: Are you pregnant?
translation: Je, wewe ni mjamzito?

source: When was your last menstrual period?
translation: Mara yako ya mwisho kupata hedhi ilikuwa lini?
back_translation: When was the last time you had your period?

source: I am 7 months pregnant.
translation: Nina mimba ya miezi 7.

source: Have you had any bleeding?
translation: Je, umekuwa na damu yoyote?

source: Are you allergic to any medicine?
translation: Je, una mzio kwa dawa yoyote?
back_translation: Do you have an allergy to any medications?

source: I am allergic to penicillin.
translation: Nina mzio wa penisilini.

source: Are you taking any medicine now?
translation: Je, unatumia dawa yoyote sasa?
back_translation: Are you taking any medication now?

source: Take two tablets three times a day.
translation: Chukua vidonge viwili mara tatu kwa siku.
back_translation: Take two tablets three times a day.

source: Take one tablet every 8 hours for 5 days.
translation: Chukua kidonge kimoja kila baada ya saa 8 kwa siku 5.
back_translation: Take one pill every 8 hours for 5 days.

source: Give the child 5 ml of the syrup twice a day.
translation: Mpe mtoto 5 ml ya mchuzi mara mbili kwa siku.
back_translation: Give the child 5 ml of the paste twice a day.

source: Take 500 mg of paracetamol when you have pain.
translation: Chukua 500 mg ya paracetamol unapokuwa na maumivu.
back_translation: Take 500 mg of paracetamol when you have pain.

source: Do not take more than 8 tablets in one day.
translation: Usichukue zaidi ya vidonge 8 kwa siku moja.
back_translation: Do not take more than 8 tablets in one day.

source: Finish all the medicine even if you feel better.
translation: Maliza dawa zote hata kama utajisikia vizuri.
back_translation: Stop taking all the medication even if you feel better.

source: Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
translation: Usinywe pombe wakati unatumia dawa hii.
back_translation: Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.

source: Take this medicine with food.
translation: Tumia dawa hii pamoja na chakula.

source: Drink plenty of clean water.
translation: Kunywa maji safi kwa wingi.

source: Mix one sachet of ORS in one litre of clean water.
translation: Changanya sacheti moja ya ORS katika lita moja ya maji safi.
back_translation: Mix one sachet of ORS in one litre of clean water.

source: Keep the baby warm.
translation: Mhifadhi mwili wa mtoto uwe na joto.

source: Continue breastfeeding the baby.
translation: Endelea kumnyonyesha mtoto.

source: Come back immediately if the child cannot drink.
translation: Rudi mara moja ikiwa mtoto hawezi kunywa.
back_translation: Call back immediately if the child is unable to drink.

source: Come back if the fever lasts more than 2 days.
translation: Rudi ikiwa homa itaendelea kwa zaidi ya siku 2.
back_translation: Return if fever persists for more than 2 days.

source: Go to the hospital if there is heavy bleeding.
translation: Nenda hospitalini ikiwa kuna kutokwa damu nyingi.
back_translation: Go to the hospital if there is a lot of bleeding.

source: Come back in one week.
translation: Rudi baada ya wiki moja.

source: Your next appointment is on 12 March.
translation: Mkutano wako ujao ni tarehe 12 Machi.
back_translation: Your next meeting is on March 12th.
